mechanism: Diclofenac may inhibit CYP3A4 and reduce progesterone metabolism, potentially increasing progesterone levels; additionally, NSAIDs can reduce efficacy of hormonal contraceptives through enterohepatic circulation interference.
action: Monitor for breakthrough bleeding if progesterone is used for contraception; consider alternative analgesia or ensure adequate contraceptive backup; counsel on potential reduced hormonal contraceptive efficacy.
